questionText:
Arrange the following statements in correct sequence to show how attitude
change takes place as per the concept
proposed by S. M. Mohsin:
 
(A) The regard and attraction of target and source towards each other
becomes mutual
(B) The target also shows an attitude change
(C) The target of change identifies with the source
(D) The source changes attitude
 
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
In S. M. Mohsin's two-step model of attitude change:
Step 1: The person who is the target of change identifies with the source (C). Identification means that the target has regard and affection for the source.
Step 2: The source shows an attitude change by first adopting the new attitude or behaviour (D). Because of identification, the mutual attraction and regard between source and target makes the target observe this change (A), and consequently the target also shows an attitude change to maintain consistency (B).
Thus, the correct sequence is (C), (D), (A), (B).
Hence, option (A) is correct.

questionText: Under which conditions are 'two-sided messages' more persuasive than 'one-sided messages'?

options.text: One-sided messages work best when the audience is initially favorable; two-sided messages work best when the audience is initially opposed or well-informed
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Attitude Change.

options.text: One-sided messages work best for professors, while two-sided messages work best for infants
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Both types of messages produce identical results across all audience types
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Two-sided messages are illegal in commercial advertising across all countries
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Attitude and Social Cognition (Attitude Change):
One-sided messages work best when the audience is initially favorable; two-sided messages work best when the audience is initially opposed or well-informed

Detailed Context:
A one-sided message (presenting only supporting arguments) is most effective when the audience already agrees with the viewpoint; a two-sided message (acknowledging and refuting counterarguments) is superior when the audience is initially hostile or highly educated.
Hence Option D is correct.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.
